pages.name: Stone Key
pages.description: A flat stone plate lies at the base of the feather. Its beveled edge fits the slit between the two halves exactly.

options.description: Insert the plate into the slit
Shine a light into the slit

pages.name: Little Guardian
pages.description: The plate slides all the way in, and something clicks inside. The stone feather opens along the seam into two halves. A small owl figurine sits in a recess at its base.

scenePatch.description: The two halves of the stone feather are open. The recess between them is empty.

pages.name: Eyes in the Dark
pages.description: The beam slips between the two halves. A pair of stone eyes flashes in the depths for a moment, but the hidden mechanism does not move.
